objective: Represent ticker, listing, delisting, symbol-change, and classification lineage with explicit source authority, confidence, and effective dates.
blocked_shortcuts: Treating final price observation as a confirmed delisting
Backfilling a current sector across historical dates

Using post-hoc disappearance flags as model features
bulk_artifact_policy: Keep security_master.db and event extracts on OpenScienceLab; commit compact specifications and summaries only.
